event_name: NHRA New England Nationals presented by bproauto

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 71 degrees, relative humidity 70 percent, barometer 29.71 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,739 feet, track temperature 99 degrees.

Vandergriff is 1 - 0 against Todd in prior events. 

Todd with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke early and clicked it off.  Vandergriff had a hole
out right in the lights for the win.  He is advancing to his third career final and second this season.

Capps is 41 - 26 against Beckman in prior events. 

Beckman with a couple tick on the tree and never trailed for the win.  Beckman launched hard and kept it
hooked up with the quickest pass of the weekend.  He is advancing to his third final round this season and
80th career final round.
